IN RESPONSE TO THE SECURITY SITUATION IN SAUDI ARABIA. CANADIAN
AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN CANADA ARE
RECOMMENDED TO NOT ENTER THE JEDDAH FIR (OEJD) DUE TO POTENTIAL
RISK TO AVIATION FROM ONGOING MILITARY ACTIVITY, INCLUDING
MISSILES, DRONES, AND AIR DEFENCE OPERATIONS. THIS NOTAM
SUPERSEDES THE ADVICE FOR SAUDI ARABIA IN AIC 17/26.
